title: Document & Evidence Center
subtitle: Documents, versions, evidence and the source register of this project. You only see what your role, clearance and room grants allow — hidden documents are never listed or counted.

list.search: Search titles and indexed document text
list.searchNote: Search covers titles and the indexed text of documents you may read. PDF, images and spreadsheets are not text-indexed in this build.
list.emptyFiltered: No visible document matches these filters.
list.emptyHint: Documents appear here once they are created and you are allowed to see them.

create.title: New document
create.classificationHint: You can choose up to your own clearance ({clearance}).
create.roomHint: Only rooms you hold a grant for are listed. Room names are managed on the partner & JV screens.
create.retentionHint: Disposal is refused before this date.
create.effect: A document record is created with classification {classification}; you upload its first version next.
create.effectRoom: Only people with a grant to the chosen room will see it.
create.effectProject: Project members with enough clearance will see it.
create.done: Document created. Upload the first version.

versions.title: Versions
versions.label: v{version}
versions.quarantinedHint: Kept for security review only — never downloadable, linkable or indexed.

upload.title: Upload a new version
upload.quarantined: The file was quarantined ({detail}). It is kept for security review only.
upload.serverChecks: The server checks the real content, size and signatures; the file name and browser-declared type are not trusted.
upload.tooLarge: This file is {size}; the limit is {limit}.
upload.tooLargeServer: The server refused the file because it exceeds the upload limit ({limit}).
upload.badType: This file type is not accepted.
upload.legalHold: New versions are refused while the document is under legal hold.

scan.notice: No enterprise malware scanner is configured. "Not scanned" means only a basic signature check ran (EICAR test file, executables, scripts) — the file is not certified clean.
scan.noticeBlocked: In this deployment unscanned files cannot be downloaded, linked or indexed until a scanner is configured.
scan.storageNotConfigured: Object storage is not configured: uploads will fail.

extraction.hint: Text index: only text, Markdown, CSV and Word files are indexed in this build; PDF, images and spreadsheets show "Not performed". No OCR is used.

classify.title: Change classification
classify.effectRaise: The document becomes {classification}; readers below that clearance lose access immediately.
classify.effectLower: The document is lowered to {classification}; more people may be able to read it.
classify.effectIndex: The search/AI index of this document is cleared at once and rebuilt with the new access rules.
classify.sod: Lowering a classification must be done by someone other than the document owner.

room.title: Move to another room
room.effect: Only people with a grant to the destination room (or project members, if no room) will see the document.
room.cleanTeamLocked: Clean-team material leaves its room only through the clean-team release process.

hold.effectPlace: Disposal and new versions are refused while the hold is active; the database enforces it too.
hold.effectRelease: Disposal becomes possible again after the retention date, through a two-person procedure.

retention.title: Set the retention date
retention.clearHint: Leave empty to remove the retention date.
retention.effect: Disposal is refused before this date.

disposal.requestEffect: A different, authorised person must execute the disposal.
disposal.requestRefused: The request is refused while a legal hold or retention date applies.
disposal.executeEffect: The document is withdrawn (soft deletion): it disappears from lists, search and downloads; versions and the audit trail are kept.
disposal.executeEvidence: Evidence links that rely on it are superseded and the linked records are reassessed.
disposal.executeSod: The requester and the document owner cannot execute the disposal.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.tabIntro: Choose a record to see and manage its evidence. Other screens show the same panel on their own records.
evidence.empty: No evidence you can see is linked to this record.
evidence.emptyHint: Evidence you are not allowed to read is not shown or counted.
evidence.conflictBanner: Conflicting evidence: at least two links contradict each other. The record must be reassessed before relying on them.
evidence.contradictsHint: Choose this only when the new evidence contradicts evidence already relied upon — both are flagged as conflicting.
evidence.contradictsNone: No — it does not contradict anything
evidence.linkEffectThis: The evidence is linked to this record.
evidence.linkUnverified: It stays unverified until someone other than you verifies it.
evidence.conflictEffect: Both links are flagged as conflicting; neither is deleted and earlier reviews are preserved.
evidence.linkedConflicting: Evidence linked and flagged as conflicting.
evidence.verifyEffect: The evidence is accepted as support for the record.
evidence.verifyIntegrity: The stored file is checked against its recorded SHA-256 first; a mismatch blocks verification.
evidence.sod: You cannot verify evidence you linked or uploaded yourself.
evidence.rejectEffect: The evidence is rejected; it is kept in the history.
evidence.supersedeEffect: The link is marked superseded and kept in the history.
evidence.reassess: Records relying on this evidence are reassessed.

picker.none: No matching record you can see.
picker.noTypes: You cannot browse any record type that takes evidence here.

sources.intro: The source register records where information came from. Report date, as-of date and extraction date are kept separately; previous sources are preserved when a newer one supersedes them.
sources.search: Search by code or file name
sources.createEffect: A source record is created; its claims enter as unverified — nothing changes current records.
sources.extractionEffect: The extraction status, date and note are recorded on the source.

fields.ownerHint: A role or function — do not enter personal names unless approved.
fields.reportDateHint: The date printed in the source itself.
fields.asOfDateHint: The date the information is effective for.
fields.supersedesHint: The previous source is kept unchanged and linked.

claims.title: Claims
claims.neverConfirmed: New claims are never confirmed on entry; a different reviewer decides.
claims.locationHint: Page, section, sheet/cell or image region.
claims.initialStatusHint: Historical statuses from old reports must be entered as Historical-unverified.
claims.mappingHint: Optional: map the claim to one field so it can be compared with the current record.
claims.historicalNotice: Historical values from this source (for example "Completed" or "On Track") are kept as source-reported values only. They are never applied as current status.
claims.historicalCannotConfirm: A historical-unverified value cannot be confirmed as current; record the current value from a new, authoritative source.
claims.reviewEffect: The claim's verification status is set; the record itself is not changed.
claims.sod: You cannot review a claim you recorded.
claims.proposeTitle: Propose the confirmed value as a change
claims.proposeEffect: A proposed change to "{value}" is sent to the record owner for review.
claims.proposeNoChange: No record is changed now; the owner applies it under change control.
claims.proposed: Change proposed — the record is unchanged until the owner approves.

compare.title: Comparison with current records
compare.hint: Side-by-side view only: nothing is merged. Confirmed claims can be proposed as changes; historical values never are.
